# Northwind Cloud Docs

> Reference documentation for Northwind Cloud's 15 cloud products. Each section below
> links to that product's introduction, core concepts, getting-started guide, and API reference.

## Atlas

Product analytics and event tracking.

- [Introduction](https://northwind-cloud.vercel.app/docs/atlas/intro.md): Product analytics and event tracking.
- [Concepts](https://northwind-cloud.vercel.app/docs/atlas/concepts.md): Core objects and data model behind Atlas — the concepts referenced throughout the rest of the docs.
- [Getting Started](https://northwind-cloud.vercel.app/docs/atlas/getting-started.md): Create an API key, install the SDK or use cURL directly, and send your first request.
- [API Reference](https://northwind-cloud.vercel.app/docs/atlas/api-reference.md): Full REST endpoint reference for Atlas: requests, responses, authentication, and error codes.
- [Migration Guide](https://northwind-cloud.vercel.app/docs/atlas/next/migration-guide.md): What changed for Atlas between the previous release and the current one.
